prompt: Static camera. Immediately a ripple of paddles goes up across the tent: the ordinary people in the rows behind lift their "£50" paddles, a few at first, then many, faces calm and plain. The heavy man in the front row grips his knees, turns sharply round over his shoulder and glares at the room, eyes wide and outraged. The clerk beside him glances sideways at him, then down. The "£50" lettering stays readable on every paddle. On the right, the masked auctioneer remains completely still behind the lectern, gavel held up, balaclava with its white ring and red triangle over his left eye exactly as it is, gloved hands only. No one talks. Sound: shuffle of chairs and paddles, a swelling murmur of a crowd, soft rain on canvas. Natural daylight inside the marquee.
